svg.title: FMI 3 Clock and associated data connections
svg.desc: At a scheduled or triggered Clock event, a source output Clock connects to a target input Clock. A separate data connection stages a source value for the target Clock. The target activates its input Clock, receives its associated data and updates discrete states; the staged value is held until an activation.
svg.text: FMI 3 Clock activation and associated data
Clock connections carry activation; associated values use their own data connections.
At the boundary: enter Event Mode, route the tick and associated data, then update discrete states.
Repeat when needed at the same time; hold the last sample until the target Clock activates.
Clock-capable participants use factor one and must be at the Clock time. Ahead ordinary sources are not sampled as current.
